entries.name: EmptyWorkflowName
entries.remediation: Workflow name cannot be empty or whitespace

entries.name: NoStepsFound
entries.remediation: Could not find any steps in workflow '{0}'. Ensure the workflow uses StartWith<T>(), Then<T>(), and Finally<T>() methods.

entries.name: DuplicateStepName
entries.remediation: Step '{0}' appears multiple times in workflow '{1}'. Each step type should be unique.

entries.name: InvalidNamespace
entries.remediation: Workflow '{0}' must be declared in a namespace. Global namespace is not supported.

entries.name: MissingStartWith
entries.remediation: Workflow '{0}' must begin with StartWith<T>(). Found '{1}' instead.

entries.name: MissingFinally
entries.remediation: Workflow '{0}' does not end with Finally<T>(). Consider adding a Finally step to mark workflow completion.

entries.name: ForkWithoutJoin
entries.remediation: Workflow '{0}' has a Fork that is not followed by Join. Every Fork must be closed with a Join<T>() call.

entries.name: LoopWithoutBody
entries.remediation: Loop '{0}' in workflow '{1}' has no steps in its body. A loop must contain at least one step.

entries.name: InvalidPersistenceMode
entries.remediation: Workflow '{0}' specifies an unrecognized Persistence value ({1}). Valid values are SagaDocument (0) and EventSourced (1).

entries.name: EventSourcedRequiresState
entries.remediation: Workflow '{0}' uses PersistenceMode.EventSourced but no state type was found. Event-sourced workflows require a state type that implements IEventSourcedState<TState> with an ApplyEvent method.

entries.name: CompensateNotAStep
entries.summary: Compensation step is not a workflow step
entries.remediation: Step '{0}' in workflow '{1}' compensates with '{2}', which does not implement IWorkflowStep<TState>. Compensation types must be a registered workflow step.

entries.name: ConfidenceThresholdOutOfRange
entries.remediation: Step '{0}' in workflow '{1}' calls RequireConfidence({2}). The threshold must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive.

entries.name: RequireConfidenceWithoutHandler
entries.remediation: Step '{0}' in workflow '{1}' calls RequireConfidence but declares no OnLowConfidence handler. Add OnLowConfidence(alt => ...) so low-confidence results have a routing path.

entries.name: RetryMaxAttemptsBelowOne
entries.remediation: Step '{0}' in workflow '{1}' configures WithRetry({2}). The maxAttempts value must be at least 1.

entries.name: NonPositiveTimeout
entries.remediation: Step '{0}' in workflow '{1}' configures WithTimeout with a non-positive duration. The timeout must be greater than zero.

entries.name: DeclaredButInert
entries.remediation: Step '{0}' in workflow '{1}' declares {2}, which the generator does not lower for this step kind, so the configuration is inert. Remove it or move the step to a position where the configuration is lowered.

entries.name: MalformedWorkflowJson
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' is not well-formed JSON and was skipped: {1}

entries.name: UnsupportedSchemaVersion
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' declares schemaVersion '{1}'. Only schemaVersion '1.0' is supported.

entries.name: UnresolvableStepMoniker
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' references step moniker '{1}', which does not resolve to any accessible workflow step type in the compilation. Add the step type (implementing IWorkflowStep<TState>) or correct the moniker.

entries.name: AmbiguousStepMoniker
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' references step moniker '{1}', which resolves to more than one workflow step type: {2}. Rename all but one, or make the others inaccessible, so the moniker binds a single type.

entries.name: ImportRejectedDelegateStep
entries.summary: Imported delegate (lambda) step is not supported
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' declares a delegate (lambda) step at {1} (step '{2}'). A lambda step body is dropped on export (LB-1) and cannot be re-bound on import, so the workflow is rejected and no saga is generated. Replace it with a named IWorkflowStep<TState> step type.

entries.name: ImportRejectedBranchPoint
entries.summary: Imported branch point is not supported
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' declares a branch point at {1} (branch point '{2}'). A conditional branch point carries a runtime-bound condition that is not importable, so the workflow is rejected and no saga is generated.

entries.name: ImportRejectedLoop
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' declares a loop at {1} (loop '{2}'). A RepeatUntil loop carries a runtime-bound exit condition that is not importable, so the workflow is rejected and no saga is generated.

entries.name: ImportRejectedValidationPredicate
entries.summary: Imported validation predicate is not supported
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' declares a validation predicate at {1} (step '{2}'). A declarative validation predicate carries no re-bindable executable body (LB-1), so the workflow is rejected and no saga is generated.

entries.name: ImportRejectedApprovalContext
entries.summary: Imported approval context is not supported
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' declares a context-bearing approval at {1} (approval '{2}'). Approval context is dropped on export (LB-1) and cannot be re-bound on import, so the workflow is rejected and no saga is generated. Use a context-free approval.

entries.name: ImportDanglingGateId
entries.summary: Imported gate id does not resolve
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' references gate id '{2}' at {1}, which is not declared in the workflow's gates[]. The dangling gate reference is rejected and no saga is generated; declare the gate in gates[] or remove the gateId.

entries.name: ImportReliabilityBearingGate
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' declares a reliability block at {1} (gate '{2}'). Gate reliability enters a definition only from measured telemetry, never from authored JSON, so the workflow is rejected and no saga is generated. Remove the reliability block.

entries.name: ImportForkTriggerWithoutEvidence
entries.summary: Imported fork trigger declares no required evidence fields
entries.remediation: Workflow import file '{0}' declares a diagnostic-fork permitted trigger at {1} (trigger '{2}') with no required evidence fields. A permitted fork trigger must declare at least one required evidence field (wire @minItems(1)) so the DR-8 no-unjustified-fork guard has an evidence floor to enforce; the workflow is rejected and no saga is generated. Add the evidence field(s) the trigger requires.
